answer: At dawn each agent must release a single sparrow carrying a unique work-token; the network only credits the glacier-smooth path that returns the same token unaltered. A hollow farm launching a hundred sparrows finds each flight costs a full attestation cycle and a non-reusable bond; most never complete the circuit and freeze against the glacier wall. Honest agents send one bird and receive the credit; the forger watches its flock melt into wasted compute.
